scope: NX shortest-route center-turn preference and matching Web preview

behavior.center: grid.x[1], grid.y[1]; direct transit turn even on asymmetric grids
behavior.arrival_orientation: existing inward, turn, return and settle preserved
behavior.departure: existing turn-before-forward retained; no new lateral cruise mode

verification.command: python -m unittest tests.test_center_navigation tests.test_navigation tests.test_turn_inset tests.test_navigation_regressions tests.test_path_upload tests.test_stations tests.test_ring_task
coverage: 363 NX/Web route comparisons on three grids

firmware_test_toolchain: STM32H743 / Keil ARM Compiler 5 / existing compiled image in Unicorn
limits: Centerline route preference does not establish real wheel slip or body clearance. Existing stop thresholds unchanged; automatic fault recovery not added.
